other_failure_modes.name: Discarded Test IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original ID column during preprocessing and uses a newly generated sequence (np.arange) for the submission file. This will cause submission failures or misaligned predictions if the evaluation system expects the original test IDs.

summary: The agent provides a solid and robust solution, incorporating appropriate data cleaning, thoughtful domain-specific feature engineering, and proper cross-validation for the LightGBM model. The only significant flaw is discarding the original test IDs and substituting them with a generated sequence in the final submission file, which would likely cause the automated evaluation to fail.
